title: FedEx Air & Ground NFL Awards Return, Delivering Recognition on the Field and Impact in Local Communities
summary: The NFL's longest-running, fan-voted awards program is back to celebrate on-field excellence and tackle food insecurity in collaboration with Feeding America
body_markdown:
**MEMPHIS, Tenn., Aug. 31, 2026** — Today, FedEx (NYSE: FDX) announced the return of the fan-voted FedEx Air & Ground NFL Awards for the 2026 season. Now in its 24th year, the program will continue its collaboration with Feeding America® to celebrate standout performances from quarterbacks, running backs, wide receivers, and tight ends.


The Air & Ground NFL Awards program turns outstanding on-field performances into vital support for communities facing food insecurity, with each weekly honor resulting in a donation to Feeding America for a local partner food bank in the two winning players’ cities.


Each week, six standout performances from the eligible four positions will be nominated for the FedEx Air & Ground NFL Players of the Week Award. New this season, fans can also cast their votes on Instagram, expanding the ways they can participate in the program. Voting is open each Monday through Wednesday at 3:00 p.m. ET at[NFL.com/FedEx](http://www.nfl.com/fedex)


, on the NFL Mobile App, via X (formerly Twitter) at[@NFL](https://twitter.com/NFL)


or on Instagram[@NFL](https://www.instagram.com/nfl/)


.


“For more than two decades, the FedEx Air & Ground NFL Awards has demonstrated how the passion of sports fans can help strengthen communities,” said Jenny Robertson, senior vice president of Global Brand and Communications at FedEx. “Together with the NFL and Feeding America, we’re honored to continue this tradition by engaging fans, recognizing outstanding athletes, and supporting local food banks in communities nationwide.”


Since the program’s inception in 2003, FedEx has donated nearly $3 million to nonprofit organizations, such as charities and children’s hospitals, in the name of winning players.


This year’s continued collaboration with Feeding America supports a nationwide network of food banks, statewide food bank associations, regional co-ops, agency partners, food pantries, and meal programs. Together, the organizations are helping expand access to nutritious food for individuals and families facing hunger in NFL communities.


“Through our collaboration with FedEx, we are turning football’s best performances into meaningful change for families in players’ backyards,” said Elizabeth Pettengill, interim vice president of Corporate and Foundation Partnerships at Feeding America. “Ending hunger takes all of us, especially now, when so many communities are feeling stretched and uncertain. Programs like this show that working together is essential to help strengthen communities and build a future where everyone has access to the food they need to thrive.”


The season will culminate in the naming of the three FedEx Air & Ground NFL Players of the Year, announced at NFL Honors ahead of Super Bowl LXI in Los Angeles, California.


“For 24 years, the NFL and FedEx have worked together to recognize outstanding talent across the league while creating meaningful impact in our community,” said Tracie Rodburg, senior vice president of global partnerships at the NFL. “FedEx is dedicated to celebrating excellence and investing in communities across the country and this reflects the shared values of our fans and the entire league.”


For more information, visit[NFL.com/FedEx](http://nfl.com/fedex)


or follow the conversation on X at #AirAndGround.


**About FedEx Corp.**
FedEx Corp. (NYSE: FDX) provides customers and businesses worldwide with a broad portfolio of transportation, e-commerce, and business services. With annual revenue of $86 billion, the company offers integrated business solutions utilizing its flexible, efficient, and intelligent global network. Consistently ranked among the world’s most admired and trusted employers, FedEx inspires its more than 450,000 employees to remain focused on safety, the highest ethical and professional standards, and the needs of their customers and communities. FedEx is committed to connecting people and possibilities around the world responsibly and resourcefully, with a goal to achieve carbon-neutral operations by 2040. To learn more, please visit[fedex.com/about](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/about.html)


.


**About Feeding America**
Rooted in the voices of neighbors facing hunger, Feeding America® unites the country to ensure everyone has access to food and a thriving future. We support tens of millions of people as part of a nationwide network of 250+ food banks, 20+ statewide food bank associations, 10+ regional co-ops and 60,000+ agency partners, food pantries and meal programs. Powered by leaders and volunteers embedded in local communities, we are one of the nation’s most effective food distribution systems to drive immediate impact today—and a catalyst for long-term change through advocating for legislation that improves food security and work to address its factors. We partner with people experiencing food insecurity, policymakers, organizations and supporters, acting united with unwavering commitment to provide nourishing food and work to end hunger at its roots so everyone can live fuller, healthier lives. Visit FeedingAmerica.org to learn more.
